topic: Using phone in the dark: myth vs fact (strain, not blindness)

youtube.title: Phone in the dark makes you blind? Myth vs Fact 📱 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Does using your phone in the dark make you go blind? Myth vs fact.
இருட்டில் போன் பார்த்தால் பார்வை போகுமா? உண்மை என்ன?

• Myth: a phone in a dark room permanently damages your eyes. There's no good evidence for that.
• Fact: it does cause eye strain: pupils keep adjusting and you blink less, so eyes feel dry, tired and achy.
• Bright screen light late at night can delay your body's sleep signal.
• Keep a room light on, lower the brightness and hold the phone at least 30 cm away.
• Children: fewer screens after dark and more outdoor time in daylight.
• Eye pain, blur that won't clear or daily headaches: get your eyes checked.

gmb.text: Does using a phone in the dark make you go blind? That's a myth; there is no good evidence it causes permanent damage. But it does cause eye strain: a bright screen in a dark room keeps your pupils adjusting and you blink less, so eyes feel dry, tired and achy. Bright screen light late at night can also delay sleep. Keep a room light on, turn the brightness down and hold the phone at least 30 cm away. For children, limit screens after dark and encourage more outdoor time in daylight. If you have eye pain, blur that doesn't clear or daily headaches, get your eyes checked. Book an eye test on WhatsApp: 044 4356 9998
